schema_policy.omission: Follow each owning schema required/default declaration; defaults validated by owning model
schema_policy.null: Only a declared null branch admits null; never substitute zero for unavailable results
schema_policy.bounds_enums_units_basis: Owning model validators and family field contracts remain authoritative
schema_policy.evolution: Review schema and caller meaning before updating snapshot; additive compatibility fields and unsafe-input corrections documented in api-stability.md
schema_policy.wall_compatibility: Retain legacy numeric-string coercion; strict family facade remains non-coercing
schema_policy.instances: Indexed tests are evidence owners, not a claim every possible payload or native workflow was executed
